voxel_m_reason: config/sensors.json depth sigma is 0.024 m at 4 m; a 0.05 m voxel spans about twice that noise and half a 0.1 m brain grid cell.
truncate_m_reason: Three 0.05 m voxels cover the TSDF zero crossing and exceed the sensor's 0.096 m depth sigma at its 8 m maximum range.
floor_exclude_m_reason: Two 0.05 m voxels plus 0.02 m cover floor discretisation and the sensor's 0.006 m sigma near the 2 m floor intersection below the 1.6 m camera.
coverage_cell_m_reason: Rasterise observed depth rays at the same 0.05 m resolution as the TSDF; coverage has this spatial uncertainty and never extends past a valid return.
depth_stride_reason: The first 15 robot_B 640x480 frames measured about 93 ms median warm integration and 9 ms layers on 2026-10-21. Both fit their budgets, so retain all sensor pixels. Strided calibration uses the original sampled pixel centres.
max_weight_reason: The measured evaluation uses 15 successive one-second observations; cap voxel confidence at that observation count so new depth keeps updating old voxels.
frame_tolerance_s_reason: Matches vision.load_frame's measured recording lookup contract, which rejects an index more than 0.5 s from the request.
integrate_budget_ms_reason: Warm updates: the recorder requests one map update per simulated second per robot. Reserve 350 ms for integration and 150 ms for layers, allowing two robots to share one second even if calls serialize. Process startup is measured separately.
layers_budget_ms_reason: The remaining 150 ms of each robot's 500 ms mapping allowance after the 350 ms integration budget; measured on a 200x200 grid of 0.1 m cells.
native_threads_reason: The recorded 640x480 sequence measured about 83 ms warm integration and 9 ms layers with one OpenCV thread per robot worker; matches vision.py and avoids two robot workers each occupying all host cores.
worker_timeout_s_reason: Allow 30 one-second recorder periods for process startup or native work under host load; a hung worker is killed and the request fails instead of blocking the server indefinitely.
accuracy_median_bound_m_reason: The first 15 one-second robot_B estimates measure 0.068612 m maximum position error and 0.191972 degrees maximum heading error. 0.068612 + 8*sin(0.191972 degrees) + one 0.05 m voxel + the sensor sigma of 0.024 m at 4 m is 0.169417 m, rounded up to 0.18 m for the median acceptance bound.
